subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land now as the narrow fresh-session recook fix, or wait for the reattach-first recovery design tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200?
rationale: The code fix is focused and proof-backed, but it intentionally preserves the two-run fallback boundary for accepted disconnects, which affects session state, model/tool side effects, and possible delivery duplication.

options.title: Land the narrow fix now
options.body: Accept the timeout-style fallback boundary for this rare disconnect path and treat reattach-first recovery as a follow-up product issue.

options.title: Fold into reattach-first
options.body: Pause this PR and have the contributor extend it into the recovery design from the related issue before landing.

options.title: Keep recook behavior unchanged
options.body: Close or replace the PR only if maintainers prefer not to change the accepted-disconnect session behavior yet.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow fix now
recommendation.body: Accept the timeout-style fallback boundary for this rare disconnect path and treat reattach-first recovery as a follow-up product issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest connection to the affected gateway agent CLI/session behavior and current-main changes in the same function.
